name: Sorvaine Wing-Panel Cape
description: Sorvaine is a small Tier 3-4 label that exists almost entirely to serve geneware users with wing modifications — a population that most mainstream outerwear manufacturers still design around rather than for. The Wing-Panel Cape is the brand's core offering: a structured cape with a full back panel that opens via a magnetic closure system running the length of the spine, allowing the garment to accommodate folded wings of varying spans without forcing the wearer to choose between being warm and being able to extend their modifications. The front falls in a clean A-line to mid-thigh; the back panel is cut in a generous trapezoid that drapes well over folded wing structures. Material is a boiled wool in deep plum, forest green, or black, with a satin lining. The silhouette is dramatic and intentional — Sorvaine does not apologize for making something that reads as theatrical, because the people who need it have already accepted that their existence reads as theatrical to those who have not adapted.
functionality: Magnetic spine closure accommodates folded wing geneware mods. Panel sizing available in three wing-span ranges.
what_it_says: You have modified your body in a way that requires the world to adapt to you, and you have found a maker who was willing to do that. You are not hiding what you are.
worn_by: dramatic fashion adopters without mods who like the silhouette
story_hooks: Sorvaine's founder has recently received a licensing demand from a corponation claiming prior design rights to the magnetic spine closure system — the demand appears to be in bad faith but defending against it could bankrupt the label

A Sorvaine Wing-Panel Cape in forest green was found at a crime scene with no body — the interior satin lining contained a hand-written message in a language that the investigating team's translation software does not recognize

The geneware wing modification community in GLMZ uses specific Sorvaine colorways as informal social signals — forest green indicates you are open to meeting new people, plum means you prefer to be left alone

physical_description.visual_profile: A dramatic, structured cape that reads as intentionally theatrical—commanding presence without apology. The front drapes in a clean A-line to mid-thigh, while the back forms a generous trapezoid silhouette that accommodates folded wing modifications. The overall impression is dignified defiance: armor-adjacent but elegant.
physical_description.fit: Structured yet flowing. The cape sits at the shoulders with enough volume to drape cleanly over the torso and folded wings without compression. The front is fitted enough to maintain clean lines; the back trapezoid expands to accommodate wing spans of varying widths.
physical_description.primary_material: Boiled wool—densely fulled for weather resistance and structural integrity, with a luxurious satin lining that contrasts tactilely and visually.
physical_description.texture: The exterior boiled wool has a slightly napped, dense surface with subtle texture from the fulling process; it catches light diffusely. The satin lining is smooth and reflective, visible at closures and when the cape moves.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep jewel tones: plum, forest green, or black. The satin lining typically in a complementary shade or rich contrast (cream, charcoal, or iridescent).
physical_description.closures: Full-length magnetic closure system running the length of the spine—allows the back panel to open completely, accommodating folded wings without compromising garment security or wearer comfort.
distinctive_features: Full-length spine-mounted magnetic closure system engineered for wing accommodation
Generous trapezoid back panel cut specifically for folded wing structures
Contrasting satin lining visible at spine opening
Boiled wool construction for durability and water resistance
Dramatic drape that reads as intentional rather than accidental
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional luxury—too specialized and well-crafted for Tier 5, too niche and independent for Tier 1-2 corpo mass production
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals geneware modification adoption, community integration, and refusal to minimize oneself. Wearer is implicitly saying: I exist visibly, I have adapted, and I dress for the body I actually have.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically well-maintained; worn-in but not distressed. The boiled wool ages gracefully, darkening slightly with time. Satin lining may show crease marks where the spine closure runs.
